title: Pricing Plugin System with Cooperative Mixins
instructions: Implement the pricing classes in `pricing.py`. `BaseFare` charges 10 per km; `SurgeMixin`, `DiscountMixin` and `TaxMixin` each call `super().calculate_fare(distance)` and then adjust the result, so the order in the class statement is the order adjustments are applied. `FinalFare` must initialise every mixin cooperatively and return 189 for distance 10, multiplier 2, discount 10 and tax 5.

evidence.label: FinalFare gives 189 for the worked example
FinalFare MRO is Tax, Discount, Surge, Base
Each mixin adjusts the fare correctly on its own
Mixins call super(), so class order decides application order
Every initialiser runs once and nothing is left over for BaseFare
Fare scales with distance, including zero
